scope: source snapshot; not yet a compiled or runtime-integrated port
local_port_modifications: tools/build-live-boot-binaries.sh: only stages the x86_64 Koronos ELF for x86_64; marks arm64/armv7 runtimes not-built; never asserts verified_binary_generation without architecture-specific validation

tools/build-live-boot-binaries.sh: Live and Jasper recovery initramfs emit event-driven progress bars and verbose /dev/console plus /var/log/mesgs logs; percentages report completed early-userspace operations, not kernel or desktop readiness.

kernel/include/chimera/process.h and kernel/core/process.cpp: selectively synchronized from ChimeraIIOS PR #247 head 5835d3da1db336a86ee7e179bc38da880ffdd3e4 to provide the address-space binding, signal queue and process-reap API already called by target_launch.cpp; the snapshot baseline remains f1609c2f8a9565a9bced61ffbe0b2366b10d1ad5, so this is not a full vendor refresh.

vendor/chimera-ii-os/source/tools/generate-aurora-media.sh: selectively synchronized from ChimeraIIOS PR #247 head 27388e4bfd7b451e0be08066b62b58798e1311e8 (byte-identical to PR #248 head 2c09dd8caa388bd70cd09f4de0d342e50c7c092b); FFmpeg uses -nostdin and /dev/null redirection so batch media generation cannot consume the here-document feeding the sound-effect loop.

vendor/chimera-ii-os/source/boot/{installation/menu.cfg,iso/grub.cfg,jasper/install.cfg,jasper/jasper.cfg,jasper/recovery.cfg,jasper/safe-mode.cfg,spitfire/spitfire-menu.cfg}: split chained file-existence tests into separate GRUB conditionals (GRUB 2.12 parser compatibility) and enforce visible 120-second menus with timeout_style=menu on nested installer, Jasper, recovery, safe-mode and Spit Fire menus.
